name: Weights & Biases
pros: Unified view from training experiment through to production trace, which no pure LLM tracer offers
Mature compliance and self-hosting story for regulated industries
Versioning and artifact lineage carry over from the ML platform, so reproducibility is genuinely first-class
Built-in guardrail and quality scorers rather than assembling them yourself
files: Artifacts, datasets, model registry, and evaluation runs with versioned lineage.
value: Two products under one account. The original platform is the widely adopted standard for training-run tracking: experiments, hyperparameter sweeps, artifacts, model registry, and reproducibility lineage. Weave layers LLM application observability on top, adding a decorator to any Python function to capture prompts, completions, token counts, cost, and latency, plus evaluation with custom and LLM-judge scorers, and pre-built guardrail scorers for toxicity, bias, PII, and hallucination. Its real advantage is continuity: for a team whose model development already lives in W&B, production traces sit beside the experiments that produced the model.
engine: Managed SaaS with enterprise self-hosting via Kubernetes. Weave SDK is the primary path, with OpenTelemetry-compatible ingest available.
status: Active. Acquired by CoreWeave; W&B Weave is the LLM and agent observability product alongside the original experiment-tracking platform.
latency: Asynchronous logging. Users have reported modest overhead on complex multi-step agent traces.

governance_note: The strongest audit story here is lineage rather than tracing: linking a production behaviour back to the training run, dataset version, and hyperparameters that produced the model is precisely the evidence chain an AI audit asks for and most stacks cannot assemble. Enterprise self-hosting with SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, HIPAA, and ISO 27001 coverage answers the residency question that blocks observability adoption in regulated settings. Weigh against that the vendor-native trace format, which raises exit cost relative to OpenTelemetry-first tools, and record the CoreWeave ownership as a dependency fact with a review date, since the parent company's strategic priorities are now part of the platform's trajectory.
training_optout: Trace and experiment content is customer data under the vendor agreement, with enterprise self-hosting available to keep prompt data inside your own VPC. Verify current terms.
